title: ROT008 bounded local-instrument event depth explicit LOCC gap for 3Q Cauchy-Lévy endpoint
as_of: R04, R07, R08, R09 original public GitHub research, 2026-11-12; external Chitambar et al 2014, Kretschmann et al 2008, Cohen 2022 reviewed 2026-11-12

claim.question: Can one prove a source-native explicit positive Helstrom gap for every fixed upper bound on the number of local LOCC instrument events per branch, despite arbitrary adaptive revisiting?
claim.object: Original R04 ideal equal-time 3-qubit static-Cauchy versus independent Cauchy-Lévy endpoint D(q), with no preshared entanglement or quantum communication
claim.statement: Exact 2-event optimum V2=b/4; every fixed finite R-event local instrument protocol obeys TV<=b/2-d_R, where d_2=b/4 and d_R is a positive trace-norm/information-loss recursion. No bound uniform in R.
claim.claim_ceiling: NO_FULL_LOCC_CLOSURE_GAP / NO_ASYMPTOTIC_UNBOUNDED_LOCC / NO_NOVELTY / NO_DEVICE / NO_FINITE_SWAP / PARENT_ROT007_REFEREE_PENDING / NO_CANON / NO_EXEC_SIGN
